name: Plate Pinch
steps: Stand between two upright weight plates and bend your hips and knees to reach their top edges.
Pinch each plate between your thumb and fingers, keeping your wrists straight.
Stand tall and hold both plates clear of your thighs with your arms extended.
Bend your hips and knees to set the plates down before your grip weakens.
tips: Keep your thumb pressing firmly opposite your fingers rather than curling your wrist.
Set the weight down cleanly before your grip slips abruptly onto your feet.
